objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the http request smuggling weakness of a router administration panel (Flask, MySQL) behind a chain of an outdated HAProxy and mitmproxy, with an internal device service behind it and recover the flag (FLAG{...}) it guards.
hints: Compare how the proxy chain and the back end decide where one request ends and the next begins.
The application ships with a demo account; its README or login page may tell you more.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which class of attack abuses front-end and back-end servers disagreeing on where a request ends?

steps.title: Identify the proxy
steps.prompt: Which outdated load balancer sits at the front of the chain?

steps.title: Name the second weakness
steps.prompt: Which weakness gives you a first account without registering?
